resources.string: The address of your Heddohon server, as you open it in a browser.
The app is a window onto that server: your music, your account and your settings stay on it. To change the address later, press and hold the app\'s icon and choose Change server.
That is not an address. It looks like https://music.example.com.
The address has to start with https://. The app opens the server in a secure window, which a plain http address cannot be.
